reasoning: The evidence strongly indicates Sassou Nguesso will win. He has won every election since 2002, controls the state apparatus and electoral bodies, faces only fragmented opposition with no serious challengers, and the two main opposition parties (UPADS and UDH-Yuki) are boycotting. His ruling PCT controls the electoral commission, courts, media, and security forces. The opposition candidates lack resources and political bases. Past elections have been marred by fraud allegations but results stood. Given his total institutional control and weak opposition, victory is near-certain.
